title: Pergamino IDE (Demo Portolan)
description: A STAC catalog aggregating 178 municipal GIS layers for the Partido de Pergamino (Buenos Aires Province, Argentina), published via the Portolan pipeline as PMTiles vector tiles. Covers cadastral parcels, administrative boundaries, infrastructure, demographics, environmental hazards, agriculture, and points of interest for the municipality and surrounding areas.
